dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Take this letter to the Ratnik headquarters. I've included all the specific tasks and required maps inside.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: This letter is to be delivered to Miss Nefer at the Curatorium of Secrets. You know how to deliver it.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: This letter is to be delivered to Mondstadt. There's nothing urgent in there, it can wait.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Depart immediately, and maintain communication using the same methods and frequency as before.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Finally, stay safe on the road. Danger pops up? Run. Can't run fast enough? Shout for help. And if shouting's not enough, run and shout at the same time.
